title: AI Trainer
company: NEW VISION GLOBAL INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a knowledgeable and enthusiastic AI Trainer / AI Lecturer to deliver practical and theoretical training in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Agentic AI and Generative AI. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to explain complex concepts through engaging classroom or online training sessions.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Conduct classroom and online training sessions on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Agentic AI, and Generative AI.

● Teach concepts related to Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI-powered tools.

● Provide hands-on demonstrations and practical exercises using AI tools.

● Explain AI concepts, algorithms, model training, and real-world applications.

● Develop training materials, presentations, lesson plans, assignments, and assessments.

● Guide learners through practical exercises, AI-based projects, and real-world use cases.

● Conduct interactive sessions, clarify doubts, and evaluate learner performance.

● Use online platforms for virtual training.

● Stay updated on emerging AI technologies, tools, and industry trends.

**Required Skills**

● Strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.

● Familiarity with Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks.

● Practical knowledge of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, prompt engineering, and AI productivity tools.

● Good understanding of LLMs, AI applications, and automation concepts.

● Excellent verbal communication, presentation, and teaching skills.

● Ability to simplify technical concepts for beginners and professionals.

● Experience in preparing training materials and conducting practical sessions.

● Ability to engage learners and support them throughout the training process.

**Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related fields, with specialization in Generative AI, LLMs, Deep Learning, NLP, or AI Automation.

**Experience**

● 2 – 7 years of experience in AI training, technical training, teaching, lecturing, AI development, or a related field is preferred.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

● Passion for teaching and knowledge sharing.

● Strong technical and problem-solving abilities.

● Comfortable conducting both theoretical and practical sessions.

● Need good communication.

● Candidates with industry experience, academic teaching experience, or online training experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Company:** Buff Institute of Design  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time  
**Department:** Training & Academics  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Preferred)

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and passionate **Data Science Trainer** to deliver industry-oriented training in Data Science, Python programming, statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise, practical project experience, and the ability to simplify complex concepts for students and aspiring professionals.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver practical and theoretical training in Data Science and related technologies.
* Teach Python programming, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and data analysis techniques.
* Explain statistics, probability, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and data preprocessing.
* Train students in machine learning algorithms, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
* Introduce data visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
* Guide students through real-world projects, case studies, assignments, and capstone projects.
* Develop course materials, presentations, lab exercises, assessments, and project documentation.
* Evaluate student performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Mentor students on portfolio development, resume preparation, and technical interview readiness.
* Stay updated with industry trends, emerging AI technologies, and current Data Science practices.
* Support academic activities, student progress tracking, and placement preparation.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in Python programming.
* Knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
* Understanding of statistics, probability, and exploratory data analysis.
* Practical knowledge of machine learning algorithms and model evaluation.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Knowledge of data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and visualization.
* Familiarity with Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, and Git/GitHub.
* Basic understanding of Generative AI and AI-assisted data workflows is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, Machine Learning, or technical training.
* Candidates with relevant industry experience and a strong project portfolio are encouraged to apply.
* Prior teaching or mentoring experience is an added advantage.

Essential Soft Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to beginners.
* Effective classroom management and student engagement.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and continuous learning.

Performance Expectations

* Deliver structured, practical, and industry-relevant training sessions.
* Ensure students complete hands-on exercises and real-world projects.
* Maintain student attendance, assessment records, and progress reports.
* Help students build demonstrable Data Science portfolios.
* Contribute to curriculum improvement and placement-oriented training.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in a growing design and technology education environment.
* A collaborative team and practical teaching environment.
* Opportunities to contribute to curriculum development and student projects.
* Professional growth through exposure to emerging technologies.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume, relevant project portfolio, and details of their teaching or industry experience.

**Apply for the Data Science Trainer position at Buff Institute of Design, Coimbatore.**

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
